name: Buzen (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Buzen city emblem in yellow: a ring of two curved strokes enclosing a stylised pointed device.
history: Municipal flag of Buzen, a city in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 3 September 1990; the emblem dates from 3 November 1955.

features.role: Buzen city emblem — a ring of two curved strokes enclosing a stylised pointed device
